non_claim_boundary: Repository-local recompute observation and interpretation; outcomes inform next decision point but do not themselves execute further layers.

triggered_surfaces_to_observe.observation_question: Did QM seam coherence state change after promotion of revised blocker definition?
Did ledger artifact transport behavior change under revised blocker authority?
Did blocker-to-authority transport patterns show meaningful change?

observation_interpretation_questions.text: Did any triggered surface show meaningful downstream state change?
Did the authoritative blocker-definition update alter ledger/blocker transport behavior in a way that matters?
If surfaces show no meaningful change, is null result itself informative?

interpretation_outcomes.condition: Surfaces show significant state change AND cascade behavior observed
interpretation_outcomes.interpretation: Promotion had downstream consequence; blocker authority update propagated measurably

interpretation_outcomes.condition: Authority registry updated but no cascade in triggered surfaces
interpretation_outcomes.interpretation: Authority surface legitimately changed but with localized effect; no broad program unblocking

interpretation_outcomes.condition: Recompute surfaces show no change AND null result not clearly interpretable
interpretation_outcomes.interpretation: Observation incomplete or signal not yet materialized; requires monitoring continuation

scope_boundaries.what_observation_does: Check triggered recompute surfaces for state change; interpret downstream consequences
scope_boundaries.what_observation_does_not_do: Execute new layers; make new claims about theorem gaps; extend promotion logic
scope_boundaries.observation_chain_stops_at: Interpretation; next step determined by findings, not predetermined

declaration.fail_closed_rule: Default to OUTCOME_3 (insufficient signal) unless surfaces clearly show change
declaration.layer_description: Recompute observation and interpretation layer. Monitors triggered surfaces, interprets downstream change, determines next decision point. Does not execute beneath this layer; findings route to next phase decision.
